mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days when the signal is active.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1% in 3 months indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) during manufacturing contraction regimes signals output capacity reduction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1.8 million units indicate weak residential demand, correlating with negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days when the signal is active.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1.8 million.

mechanism_narrative: Annual CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual rise > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate increases (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5% and 0.2pp respectively in 3 months indicate labor market confusion, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), rate hikes reduce liquidity, producing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.
